title: Naga, Northern Rengma | Ethnologue Free
text: Northern Rengma Naga is a stable indigenous language of India. It belongs to the Sino-Tibetan language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by all in the ethnic community.
